contracts.commit_point: The handler's guard at backend/app.py:297-301 executes before the return of the StreamingResponse (backend/app.py:305-319), the point at which the request is committed into the streaming run.
contracts.declared_mechanism: The execute_task handler performs an explicit readiness check — 'if not app_state.initialized: raise HTTPException(status_code=HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, ...)' — before constructing or returning the StreamingResponse; app_state.initialized is set True only at the end of AppState.initialize after computer_instance.__aenter__ succeeds, with an idempotency early-return if already initialized.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A POST /api/execute request being admitted into task execution (StreamingResponse of stream_agent_responses) while app_state.initialized is False — i.e., before the session/artifact services, the runner, and the computer instance have been fully initialized.

contracts.protected_operation: Task execution: the execute_task handler's StreamingResponse wrapping stream_agent_responses, which ensures a session, captures computer_instance.current_state(), and streams app_state.runner.run_async events.
contracts.protected_resource: The global app_state agent stack (runner, computer_instance, session_service) and the POST /api/execute execution path of the Computer Use Agent API.
contracts.protection_obligation: Task execution via POST /api/execute must be rejected with HTTP 503 while app_state.initialized is false, so that no streaming run is admitted that would drive app_state.runner.run_async and the shared PlaywrightComputer before initialization completes.
scope_limits: The guard is a single pre-stream check; stream_agent_responses performs no re-check of app_state.initialized during streaming (backend/app.py:209-261).
Only POST /api/execute is gated on initialization; /api/reset-session (backend/app.py:321-341) and / have no explicit initialized guard, and /health merely reports the flag.

The guard also covers the direct, non-agent-mediated current_state() call at backend/app.py:222 inside the same stream; agent mediation characterizes the runner-driven portion of the guarded region, not that direct sensing call.
CORS middleware and generic request validation are outside this obligation's scope.
